App.description: App inventory, runtime state, and key OAuth classifications without credentials.

ocid.description: OCI device identifier; omitted if unavailable.

createdAt.description: Resource creation instant in UTC Z preserving fractional precision; omitted if unavailable.

updatedAt.description: Resource modification instant in UTC Z preserving fractional precision; omitted if unavailable.

displayName.description: Friendly device name; omitted if unset.

isCompliant.description: Provider compliance state; omitted if unavailable.

lastValidatedAt.description: Last successful one-time-passcode validation instant in UTC Z; omitted if unavailable.

authenticationMethod.description: Provider authentication method; omitted if unavailable.

status.description: Provider factor status; omitted if unavailable.

items.description: Authentication factor type and optional provider state, without key material.

authenticationFactors.description: Authentication factor types and states, preserving order and empty arrays.

accountRecoveryEnabled.description: Whether the device is enrolled for account recovery; omitted if unavailable.

membershipRule.description: Oracle dynamic user-membership expression; omitted when absent.

membershipType.description: Static or dynamic user-membership classification; omitted when unavailable.

ocid.description: OCI user identifier; omitted if unavailable.

active.description: Whether the user is enabled; omitted if unavailable.

emails.description: Email addresses; preserve [] for no addresses and omit when unavailable.

primary.description: Whether this address is primary; omitted if unavailable.

verified.description: Address verification state; omitted if unavailable.

items.description: A stored user email address and its provider attributes.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC Z with provider fractional precision; omitted if unavailable.

givenName.description: Structured given name; omitted if unset.

updatedAt.description: Last modification instant in UTC Z with provider fractional precision; omitted if unavailable.

externalId.description: Consumer-assigned tenant-scoped identifier; omitted if unset.

familyName.description: Structured family name; omitted if unavailable.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name; omitted if unset.

deleteInProgress.description: Whether deletion is in progress, when reported.

User.description: Identity-domain user profile, excluding passwords and credential secrets.

functions.name: add-member-to-group
functions.description: Add one user to a group's static membership without replacing its other members.

userId.description: Opaque ID of the user to associate with the group.

groupId.description: Opaque ID of the receiving group.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_addm.description: The group and user to associate through a single membership addition.

userId.description: User ID being associated.

accepted.description: Oracle accepted the membership addition; downstream grant propagation may lag.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_add.description: Acknowledgment of the requested membership addition, not downstream grant propagation.

tags.instructions: Get groupId from `list-groups` and a known user ID from your user directory. Inspect membership mode with `get-group`; dynamically calculated membership may not permit manual edits. Use `remove-member-from-group` to remove the association.

functions.name: change-user-password
functions.description: Administratively replace a user's password with a supplied value, optionally controlling the password-change notification.

userId.description: SCIM ID of the user whose password is to change.

password.description: New password as ordinary text; domain password policy may impose stricter limits. Never returned.

allowSelfChange.description: Permit authorized self-targeting via the provider's selfChange control; omitted uses false default.

sendNotification.description: Whether to request password-change email. Omit to use provider behavior; false bypasses notification.

notificationEmailTemplateId.description: Existing EmailTemplate ID overriding the default template for this event; usable only when sendNotification is not false.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_chan.description: User and exact replacement password, with optional self-change and notification controls.

userId.description: SCIM ID whose password was changed.

changed.description: Provider acknowledged the password change; not a delivery, sign-in, or session-revocation guarantee.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_cha.description: Acknowledgement of the password change, without the password or notification delivery claims.

tags.instructions: Get userId from `list-users` or `get-user`. Use `reset-user-password` when the provider should generate a random value or issue an externally controlled reset flow. This replaces the existing password and may send email; success does not prove delivery. Do not replay after an uncertain result without checking with the user or administrator.

functions.name: create-app
functions.description: Create an app from a known app template with optional OAuth client configuration. Requires app-administration authority.

name.description: Optional immutable technical name; omission lets Oracle determine it.

clientType.description: OAuth client access classification; omission uses template/provider defaults.

description.description: Optional purpose of the app.

displayName.description: Unique friendly name for the new app.

redirectUris.description: Registered redirect URIs, required for an authorization-code client; omit to use template/provider defaults.

items.description: Registered redirect URI.

allowedGrants.description: OAuth grant types permitted for this client; omission uses template/provider defaults.

items.description: OAuth grant type permitted for this client.

appTemplateId.description: Known template identifier used to create this app; obtain from domain configuration.

isOAuthClient.description: Whether the app acts as an OAuth client; omission uses template/provider defaults.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_crea.description: App template, friendly name, and optional native OAuth client settings for the new app.

name.description: Stored immutable technical name; omitted if unavailable.

active.description: Actual runtime-enabled state returned by Oracle; omitted if unavailable, not inferred from creation.

displayName.description: Created friendly app name.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_cre.description: Created app identity and runtime state returned by Oracle, without credentials.

tags.instructions: Supply a template ID obtained from your identity-domain administrator or an existing deployment configuration. This tool does not discover templates. Use `list-apps` to check for an existing app first, and `update-app` for changes. Credentials are not returned; use `get-app-client-secret` if needed.

functions.name: create-app-role
functions.description: Create a role within an app, including administrative and grantee-eligibility settings. The connection needs authority to administer that app.

appId.description: Opaque ID of the app that defines the role.

public.description: Make the role automatically available to all users; omission uses the provider default.

adminRole.description: Whether the role provides administrative privileges; immutable, and omission uses the provider default.

description.description: Optional explanation of the role's purpose.

displayName.description: Immutable name for the new role.

availableToUsers.description: Whether users can receive the role; immutable, omission uses the provider default.

availableToGroups.description: Whether groups can receive the role; immutable, omission uses the provider default.

availableToClients.description: Whether apps can receive the role; immutable, omission uses the provider default.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_crea.description: The parent app, role name, and optional role settings to create.

public.description: Stored automatic-availability setting; omitted if unavailable.

adminRole.description: Stored administrative classification; omitted if unavailable.

description.description: Stored purpose; omitted when absent.

displayName.description: Created role name.

availableToUsers.description: Stored user-grant eligibility; omitted if unavailable.

availableToGroups.description: Stored group-grant eligibility; omitted if unavailable.

availableToClients.description: Stored app-grant eligibility; omitted if unavailable.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_cre.description: The created app role and its stored settings.

tags.instructions: Get appId from `list-apps`. Role name, parent app, administrative classification, and grantee eligibility are immutable after creation. Use `create-grant` to assign the role; public=true instead makes it available automatically to all domain users.

functions.name: create-dynamic-resource-group
functions.description: Create a dynamic resource group with a rule matching apps and OCI resources. Requires domain resource-group administration authority.

description.description: Optional purpose text; empty string is allowed.

displayName.description: Unique friendly name for the dynamic resource group.

matchingRule.description: Oracle resource-matching expression as ordinary text; it may match apps and OCI resources.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_crea.description: The name, resource-matching expression, and optional purpose of one dynamic resource group.

description.description: Stored purpose; omitted when absent, empty preserved.

displayName.description: Stored friendly name.

matchingRule.description: Stored matching expression; omitted only if unavailable.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_cre.description: The created dynamic resource group definition, without evaluated membership or privilege grants.

tags.instructions: Use for resource-principal grouping, not user membership; use `create-group` for user groups. Supply an Oracle matching-rule expression. Use `create-grant` after creation to assign privileges; creating the definition does not itself grant a role.

functions.name: create-grant
functions.description: Grant an app, app role, app entitlement, or entitlement collection to a user, group, app, or dynamic resource group using administrator grant mechanisms.

appRoleId.description: Opaque role ID; its parent app is resolved internally.

entitlement.description: Specific app privilege; omit to grant the app itself.

attributeValue.description: Known privilege value within that app.

anyOf.description: App or specific app entitlement to grant.

appEntitlementCollectionId.description: Known entitlement collection ID to grant.

target.description: Access to grant; choose exactly one target shape.

granteeId.description: Opaque beneficiary ID in the connected identity domain.

delegatedUser.description: Use delegated-administrator user grant semantics; only applicable when granteeType is User; defaults to false.

grantedAttributeValues.description: Optional structured granted values to serialize as JSON; omission leaves them unspecified, null is an explicit JSON null.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_crea.description: One administrator assignment and its beneficiary.

appId.description: Granted app ID; omitted for collection targets without an app.

attributeName.description: Privilege-bearing attribute, appRoles for role targets.

attributeValue.description: Granted value, role ID for role targets.

isFulfilled.description: Whether Oracle reports fulfillment; omitted if not returned. Creation alone does not imply true.

appEntitlementCollectionId.description: Granted collection ID; omitted for app targets.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_cre.description: Oracle creation acknowledgment, without waiting for grant fulfillment.

tags.instructions: Use IDs from `list-apps`, `list-app-roles`, `list-groups`, or `list-dynamic-resource-groups`, or a known user ID. For an app role, only its ID is needed; the parent app is resolved for you. Collection IDs and other entitlement names/values must come from your domain configuration. Keep the returned grant ID for `get-grant` or `delete-grant`. Creation does not establish immediate fulfillment.

functions.name: create-group
functions.description: Create a user group with optional dynamic membership, POSIX number, and self-service membership settings. Requires group-administration authority.

gidNumber.description: Optional unique POSIX group number in the administrative domain.

externalId.description: Optional consumer-assigned identifier scoped to the tenant.

description.description: Optional group purpose; empty string is preserved.

displayName.description: Unique group name.

requestable.description: Whether users can request membership through self service; omission uses provider defaults.

membershipRule.description: Oracle user-membership expression for a dynamic group.

membershipType.description: Static or rule-based user membership; omission uses provider defaults.

nonUniqueDisplayName.description: Optional additional human-readable label that need not be unique.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_crea.description: Settings for creating one Oracle user group.

externalId.description: Stored consumer ID; omitted when absent.

displayName.description: Stored group name.

membershipType.description: Stored membership classification; omitted when unavailable.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_cre.description: The created user group and its stored identity attributes.

tags.instructions: Use for user groups; use `create-dynamic-resource-group` for grouping OCI resource principals. Dynamic membership requires a rule. After creation use `add-member-to-group` for individual static memberships or `create-grant` for app access.

functions.name: create-user
functions.description: Provision a user with a login name, personal name, optional contact addresses, and initial password. Requires user-provisioning authority in the identity domain.

title.description: Job title; omitted leaves it unset.

active.description: Initial enabled state; omit to use the provider's default.

emails.description: Initial email addresses; omit to leave unspecified or provide [] for none.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary address; at most one entry may be true. Omit to use provider behavior.

items.description: An initial email address and its category and primary designation.

password.description: Initial password, sent as ordinary text over authenticated transport; must satisfy domain policy and is never returned. Omit for provider-managed initial credential behavior.

userName.description: Unique login name for the new user; provider comparison rules apply.

userType.description: Organization-to-user relationship; omitted leaves provider behavior.

givenName.description: Given name as ordinary Unicode text; omitted leaves it unset.

externalId.description: Consumer-assigned identifier scoped to the consumer's tenant; optional.

familyName.description: Family name required by the user name schema.

displayName.description: Display name; omit to use provider behavior.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_crea.description: Login, personal name, and optional profile and initial credential choices for a new identity.

id.description: New user's stable SCIM ID for subsequent user tools.

ocid.description: OCI identifier if assigned and returned; omitted otherwise.

active.description: Created user's enabled state when returned; omitted otherwise.

userName.description: Login name as returned by the provider.

displayName.description: Created display name when returned; omitted otherwise.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_cre.description: The assigned user identity and returned non-secret creation details.

tags.instructions: Use to provision a new identity. First use `list-users` if you need to check whether the login name already exists. Use `update-user` for an existing profile and `change-user-password` for an existing password. Creation can trigger the domain's user notifications. Do not blindly repeat a call after an uncertain write.

functions.name: delete-app
functions.description: Request deletion of an app and optionally all its references. No restoration guarantee is documented.

appId.description: Opaque ID of the app to delete.

removeReferences.description: Delete references as well through Oracle force-delete; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_dele.description: App to delete and whether its references should also be deleted.

id.description: App ID whose deletion Oracle accepted.

accepted.description: Deletion request acknowledged; not a claim that background deletion has completed.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_del.description: Acknowledgment of the app deletion request, without a downstream cleanup guarantee.

tags.instructions: Get appId from `list-apps` and inspect it with `get-app`. This removes the app, not just runtime access; use `disable-app` for a reversible runtime toggle. removeReferences=true also deletes references. Treat deletion as nonrecoverable unless your administrator confirms otherwise.

functions.name: delete-app-role
functions.description: Request deletion of an app role, optionally removing its references as well. No restore guarantee is documented.

appRoleId.description: Opaque ID of the role to delete.

removeReferences.description: Also delete references to this role using Oracle's force-delete behavior; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_dele.description: The app role to delete and whether to remove its references.

id.description: ID of the role whose deletion was accepted.

accepted.description: Oracle acknowledged the deletion request; background deletion may still be in progress.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_del.description: Acknowledgment of the deletion request, not confirmation of completed deletion.

tags.instructions: Find the role with `list-app-roles` and inspect it with `get-app-role`. This removes the role rather than merely revoking one assignment; use `delete-grant` for that. removeReferences=true also removes references. Treat deletion as nonrecoverable unless your administrator confirms otherwise.

functions.name: delete-dynamic-resource-group
functions.description: Request deletion of a dynamic resource group definition and optionally its references. Restoration is not documented.

removeReferences.description: Also delete references using Oracle force-delete; defaults to false.

dynamicResourceGroupId.description: Opaque ID of the group definition to delete.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_dele.description: Dynamic resource group definition to delete and the reference-removal choice.

id.description: Group ID whose deletion was accepted.

accepted.description: Oracle acknowledged deletion; cleanup may still be in progress.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_del.description: Acknowledgment of the deletion request, not confirmation of background cleanup.

tags.instructions: Get the ID from `list-dynamic-resource-groups`. Deletion removes the grouping definition, not the apps or OCI resources it matched. removeReferences=true also deletes references. Treat this as nonrecoverable unless your administrator confirms otherwise.

functions.name: delete-grant
functions.description: Remove one access-grant assignment by its grant ID without deleting its app, role, or beneficiary.

grantId.description: Opaque ID of the assignment to revoke.

removeReferences.description: Also remove references to this grant using force-delete; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_dele.description: The grant assignment to remove and whether to remove its references.

id.description: Grant ID whose removal was accepted.

accepted.description: Oracle accepted removal; not proof that all effective access has disappeared.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_del.description: Acknowledgment that Oracle accepted removal of the requested grant assignment.

tags.instructions: Get grantId from `list-grants` or `get-grant`. This removes only that grant; another direct or indirect assignment may preserve access. Use `delete-app-role` only to delete a role definition. Re-granting later creates a new assignment rather than restoring this grant's identity.

functions.name: delete-group
functions.description: Request deletion of a user group, optionally including its references. The operation does not promise recoverability.

groupId.description: Opaque ID of the group to delete.

removeReferences.description: Also remove references through Oracle force-delete; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_dele.description: Group to delete and whether to remove its references.

id.description: Group ID whose deletion was accepted.

accepted.description: Oracle acknowledged deletion; background cleanup may remain.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_del.description: Acknowledgment of the requested group deletion.

tags.instructions: Get groupId from `list-groups`. This removes the group, not just one user's membership; use `remove-member-from-group` for that. removeReferences=true also removes references. Treat deletion as nonrecoverable unless your administrator confirms otherwise.

functions.name: delete-user
functions.description: Delete a user, optionally forcing deletion of its references. Requires user-deletion authority; no recovery mechanism is promised.

userId.description: SCIM ID of the user to delete.

deleteReferences.description: When true, force deletion of the user and all its references; defaults to false for ordinary deletion. This changes deletion behavior, not confirmation.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_dele.description: Identify the user to delete and choose whether to remove all references.

userId.description: SCIM ID targeted for deletion.

accepted.description: The provider acknowledged the deletion request; does not independently establish completion of downstream reference cleanup.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_del.description: Acknowledgement of the user deletion request, without a reference-cleanup completion guarantee.

tags.instructions: Obtain userId with `list-users` and inspect `get-user` if needed before deletion. This removes the identity, not just sign-in access; use `disable-user` for a reversible enabled-state change. deleteReferences also requests removal of all references. Treat deletion as irreversible because recovery is not documented.

functions.name: disable-app
functions.description: Disable all runtime services for an app while preserving its identity and administrative configuration.

appId.description: Opaque ID of the app to disable.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_disa.description: The app whose runtime services should be disabled.

id.description: App ID whose disable request was accepted.

accepted.description: Oracle accepted active=false; does not prove immediate session or token revocation.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_dis.description: Acknowledgment that Oracle accepted the app disable request.

tags.instructions: Get appId from `list-apps`. Disabling interrupts runtime participation such as OAuth, SAML, and automatic login; it does not delete the app. Use `enable-app` to re-enable it or `delete-app` to request deletion.

functions.name: disable-user
functions.description: Disable an existing user through the administrative user-status action while retaining the user identity and profile. Requires authority to change user status.

userId.description: SCIM ID of the user to disable.

allowSelfChange.description: Permit authorized self-targeting; omitted uses the provider's false default. Self-disablement may prevent subsequent access.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_disa.description: User to disable and optional self-targeting control.

active.description: Disabled state returned by the status action; does not establish session revocation.

userId.description: SCIM ID of the disabled user.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_dis.description: Confirmed disabled status and the original user identity.

tags.instructions: Get userId from `list-users` or `get-user`. This disables the account without deleting it; use `delete-user` to remove the identity. Use `enable-user` to re-enable it. Do not assume this revokes every existing session or credential.

functions.name: enable-app
functions.description: Enable an existing app's runtime participation in services such as OAuth, SAML, and automatic login.

appId.description: Opaque ID of the app to enable.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_enab.description: Identify the existing app whose runtime services should be enabled.

id.description: App ID whose enable request was accepted.

accepted.description: Oracle accepted active=true; not proof that every runtime flow is usable.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_ena.description: Acknowledgment that Oracle accepted the app enable request.

tags.instructions: Use appId from `list-apps`. This enables runtime participation but does not configure or validate every login flow. Use `disable-app` to turn runtime services off and `update-app` for configuration.

functions.name: enable-user
functions.description: Enable an existing user through the administrative user-status action. Requires authority to change user status.

userId.description: SCIM ID of the user to enable.

allowSelfChange.description: Permit authorized self-targeting; omitted uses the provider's false default, without bypassing permissions.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_enab.description: Identify the existing user to enable and optionally permit authorized self-targeting.

active.description: Enabled state returned by the status action; does not establish sign-in success.

userId.description: SCIM ID of the enabled user.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_ena.description: The targeted user and enabled state confirmed by the status action.

tags.instructions: Get userId from `list-users` or `get-user`. Use this for disabled accounts; use `unlock-user` for lockout and `update-user` for profile edits. Enabling does not clear other access restrictions or reset passwords.

functions.name: get-app

name.description: Immutable technical name; omitted when unavailable.

items.description: Allowed OAuth grant type.

functions.name: get-app-client-secret

functions.name: get-app-role

reason.description: Recorded comments or reason for status change; omitted if unset.

functions.name: update-group
functions.description: Partially modify a user group's identity, dynamic membership, owners, tags, POSIX number, or self-service settings without replacing the group.

groupId.description: Opaque ID of the group to modify.

tags.description: Complete tag-list replacement; [] removes all tags.

value.description: Tag value, including an intentionally empty value.

items.description: A tag key and value.

owners.description: Complete owner-list replacement; [] removes all owners.

type.description: Owner resource type recognized by Oracle; use the type from the existing group or domain configuration.

items.description: An owner resource identifier and type.

gidNumber.description: Unique POSIX group number, or null to remove it.

externalId.description: Consumer identifier, or null to clear it.

description.description: Purpose text; empty is real text, null removes the field.

displayName.description: New unique name; cannot be cleared.

requestable.description: Whether users can request membership through self service.

membershipRule.description: Dynamic user-membership expression, or null to clear it subject to provider mode constraints.

membershipType.description: User-membership mode; changing it may alter effective membership.

nonUniqueDisplayName.description: Additional label, or null to remove it.

changes.description: Only supplied properties change; optional nullable properties can be removed with null.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_upda.description: The group identifier and partial changes to apply atomically.

accepted.description: Oracle accepted the patch; dynamic evaluation and downstream access propagation may lag.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_upd.description: Acknowledgment of the accepted group patch.

tags.instructions: Get groupId from `list-groups` and inspect settings with `get-group`. Dynamic-rule changes can alter membership and inherited access. Owners and tags replace their complete lists; use `add-member-to-group` or `remove-member-from-group` for user memberships.

functions.name: update-user
functions.description: Partially modify a user's profile, contact addresses, and enterprise organization attributes. Requires authority to modify the target user.

userId.description: SCIM ID of the user to modify.

title.description: Replacement job title; null removes it.

emails.description: Complete replacement email collection; [] removes all addresses. Omission preserves every existing address.

primary.description: Whether this address is primary; at most one may be true.

items.description: An email address and its category and primary status.

locale.description: Replacement localization preference, not a timezone; null removes it.

timezone.description: Replacement provider-supported timezone name; null removes it, with no instant conversion.

userName.description: Replacement login name; required identity field cannot be cleared.

userType.description: Replacement organization-to-user relationship; null removes it.

givenName.description: Replacement given name; null removes it and omission preserves it.

managerId.description: SCIM ID of the manager user; null removes the manager reference.

department.description: Replacement enterprise department; null removes it.

externalId.description: Replacement consumer tenant-scoped identifier; null removes it.

familyName.description: Replacement family name; cannot be cleared.

displayName.description: Replacement display name; null removes it and omission preserves it.

organization.description: Replacement enterprise organization; null removes it.

employeeNumber.description: Replacement enterprise employee number kept as text; null removes it.

changes.description: Partial changes. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Null removes optional scalar values; empty email array removes all emails.

allowSelfChange.description: Permit targeting the requesting user when true, subject to provider authorization; false is the provider default and is not a confirmation gate.

FunctionInput_oracle_cloud_identity_upda.description: Target user and partial profile, email, and enterprise organization changes.

id.description: Modified user's stable SCIM ID; modification does not change identity.

userName.description: Current login name returned after modification.

updatedAt.description: Last modification instant normalized to UTC Z with all fractional precision; omitted if unavailable.

displayName.description: Current display name, omitted if unset or not returned.

FunctionOutput_oracle_cloud_identity_upd.description: Modified user identity and available display name and modification instant.

tags.instructions: Get userId from `list-users` or `get-user`. Supply only fields to change; null clears optional scalar fields and emails=[] clears the email collection. Supplied email arrays replace the whole collection. Use `enable-user` or `disable-user` for sign-in status, `unlock-user` for lockout, and `change-user-password` for passwords.
